intro.text: A Terris teenager who studied in the Village alongside Wax and Telsin Ladrian.

items.text: Around 314 Kwashim, Forch and Idashwy skipped a meditation assignment to wait in the forest for Telsin, planning to sneak off for drinks elsewhere in Elendel. Kwashim was annoyed to see Wax, a teacher's pet who might give them away, and enjoyed his nerves as they spied on the Synod. Hearing Vwafendal was busy with an emergency, she slipped out the Tin Gate with Forch and Telsin; Wax stayed behind.

personality.text: Rebellious and casual about her studies; she has often sneaked into the city to drink.
